subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: POC milestone owners, acceptance criteria, blockers
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: POC milestone owners, acceptance criteria, blockers

Elena / Finera team —

Following our Friday session I wanted to capture the MAP checkpoint for this week and call out owners/action items so nothing slips as we head toward the acceptance gate. Summary below plus attached MAP spreadsheet and the evaluation checklist.

What we covered:
- Current POC scope: inference throughput, latency under 95th pct, and cost per 1M tokens for a 30-day simulated run.
- Two acceptance gates: 1) Functional (feature parity for inference routes) by 2026-12-10; 2) Performance (latency & throughput) by 2026-12-17.

Action items (owner — due):
- Provide Finera traffic profile (p95 seq length, average request size) — Elena / Marco — due 2026-11-26.
- Share SOC2 artifacts and RFI answers — Ben (sales security pack) — due 2026-11-27.
- Run 48-hour simulated run on Dedicated trial cluster, capture token-cost delta — Marissa (CS) — start 2026-11-28, results by 2026-12-02.
- Confirm canary rollout window and IP allowlist for staging — Lauren (partner ops) — due 2026-11-30.

Current blockers / risks:
- Finera still needs to confirm traffic profile (affects kernel selection and batching recommendations).
- Procurement — PO cadence expected after acceptance; if procurement stalls beyond 2026-12-20, risk to target production date.
- Security asks: Finera has an additional encryption/HSM question that may require infra team input.

Acceptance criteria (short list):
1) Functional: identical output shape and tool-calling behavior for core endpoints.
2) Stability: no more than 2% error rate during 48-hour run.
3) Performance: 95th percentile tail latency < 250ms on dedicated trial under the provided profile.
4) Cost: within 15% of projected baseline in MAP (adjusted for quantization).

Attachments: MAP-Finera-v1.xlsx (milestones & owners), POC-eval-checklist.pdf (detailed tests), Security-RFI-answers.docx (initial answers).

Proposed next sync: Tue 2026-12-01 10:00 CET (15 min) to review the 48-hour run plan and any outstanding RFIs.

Thanks — Jonas

-- 
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +44 20 7946 0991

Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: POC milestone owners, acceptance criteria, blockers

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear note. Quick replies inline:

- Traffic profile: attaching the initial export from our gateway team. Marco will validate; expect a final version by Thursday 2026-11-26. (Attachment: finera_traffic_profile.csv)
- Regarding the HSM question: we can provide a sequence diagram of our key flow but will need your infra/security to confirm supported KMS integrations.
- Agree on the two acceptance gates and the dates. We will prioritize the 48-hour run once Marissa confirms plan.

One ask from my side: can the 48-hour run also include an A/B variant where quantization is enabled? We want to see delta in quality vs. cost.

I'll block the proposed 2026-12-01 slot; if anything changes I'll flag.

Best,
Elena
